name: Delete an SMS campaign
description: Delete an SMS campaign. Delete an SMS campaign by its campaign ID. Only campaigns that have not been scheduled or sent can be deleted; attempting to delete a campaign that is queued, in process, or has been sent with recipients will return a 403 permission denied error.
